searchText: why this block couldn't reach finality https://beaconcha.in/epoch/18940 ? for how long it needs to keep participation>66% for it finalize? <@!551157969367334912> if i recall correctly, that block had less than 66.6% you need 3 in a row to finalize > Maybe some people that stopped their nodes wanted to validate again but were close of being expulsed and than they loss even being honest and got ejected, maybe that's desirable? <@!551157969367334912> I might get ejected even being a 'honest' validator, always kept my validators running. Lets see. But oh boy am I happy its just Göeth.. does anyone here have a theory on the wild fluctuations in participation between epochs on Medalla at the moment? one epoch will be above 60%, then it drops back to 40% is it just the random sampling of offline validators, or could there be more to it? I see nodes low on RAM being mentioned, but how could getting close to the treshold affect RAM usage? Now my 24h Loss increased by 0,01 ETH, total 0,11 ETH. So this daily loss for honest nodes also will get higher and higher? Why beaconcha.in is saying I only have 32% Att. Effectiveness? Im running nimbus 24/7 nimbus is using 2,3GiB of ram <@!687950695218937857> I guess the more ETH has voted the more signatures need to be aggregated and checked which could push low RAM nodes over the edge as participation increases in an epoch. I don't know the spec 100% though to be honest. hmm, interesting. But during finality even more ETH votes though? I'm not too sure on the inner workings of the clients here either though
